item: row 329: a restore never follows a volume swapped for a link after its check
summary: decrypt_stream, stream_key_opens and decrypt_file take follow_links and identity; the stream restore, its verify, the wrong-key probe and the oo-volumes-1 reassembly open backup-folder volumes without following a link and only as the file checked before anything was read (parity-rebuilt volumes excepted); a refusal fails closed and never reads as a wrong passphrase; the app's own sealed files keep following links.
